==Biography==
===2016 Preseason===
Kim "'''Roach'''" Kang-hee joined [[NaJin e-mFire]] as a sub on December 24, 2015. The team renamed to [[e-mFire]] while they searched for a new organization. In February, that organization was found, and they renamed once again to [[Kongdoo Monster]].
===2016 Season===
During the [[LCK/2016 Season/Spring Season|2016 LCK Spring Season]], Kongdoo Monster went 1-17 in sets, ending in last place. This forced them to play a relegation match against challenger team [[MVP]], who defeated them 3-1 and relegating them to [[Challengers Korea/2016 Season/Summer Season|Challengers Korea 2016 Summer]].

== Trivia ==

* He did the dance cover of Wild Eyes along with his former [[Kongdoo Monster]] teammates.<ref>[https://youtu.be/PNL4dik9bEU 콩두몬스터 신화 "Wild Eyes" 연습 영상 (Dance Practice Video) (댄스학원 댄스조아) <nowiki>[</nowiki>Translated<nowiki>]</nowiki>] ''youtube.com''</ref>
